host: Windows with Python 3.12 resolving relative links under docs/

observed.note: crossRepoLinks are references into sibling checkouts. They resolve only when those repositories are present in the same workspace, so they are reported separately rather than counted as broken.
observed.finding: docs配下の相対Markdownリンクを、そのリンクを含むファイルの位置から解決し、実在するファイルに着地するかを点検する。リンク先が存在していても、基準ディレクトリを誤ると壊れる。

scope: Resolves every relative .md link under docs/ against the file that contains it and reports links that do not land on an existing file, plus links pointing outside the checkout when --strict is given. It checks resolution only: a link to the wrong but existing document is not detected, and anchors after # are not validated.
